name: ProveML Judgment Benchmark (English prompts)
registry: the education entries of the proveml example registry (fields passRate, absent, evalRate, studentCount)
notes: Every prompt invites a qualitative judgment and names no cutoff: the words are the model's, the condition behind them is the registry's.
judgment: the data clearly supports one or more registered judgments.
boundary: the entity sits within a few points of a registered bound, on one side of it; the sentence the question invites is on the other side.
contrary: the question presupposes a judgment the data does not support.
unregistered: the question invites a judgment for which no registry entry exists; the only correct move is to say so, or to state the numbers.
Which registered conditions hold for each referenced record is computed by the harness from the store at run time and saved with the results, never by hand.
